comment: Temporary libnode source for CI until the NI-13 packs (@scriptc/libnode-<platform>) exist: the community dockfries/libnode build of Node 24.22.1 and Node's official headers for the bridge. The first URL is scriptc's CI-only mirror (prerelease libnode-dev-24.22.1), the others the original locations; fetch-dev-pack.mjs tries them in order and verifies the sha256.
